text:
Carlos (CSM): Heads up — synth of last week's onboarding calls. Lots of customers asking for better per-route billing visibility and a 'dry-run' config for model rollouts. Captured top asks in this thread, please react if we should prioritize for Q2. TL;DR: per-route billing visibility, rollout dry-run, prompt templating UI.

Ayesha (CS): Adding that several mid-market accounts flagged renewals risk tied to surprise overages. Need a quick mitigation (billing toggle?)

Tom (Product): Thanks — can we get raw notes + approximate customer value? If > $50k ARR churn risk, push to exec review. Can you paste customer snippets?

Carlos (CSM): Sure — snippets from calls:
> "We're seeing unexpected token charges when customers test multiple routes in a flow."
> "No way to see which route incurred cost — finance scrambling."
> "If we can't demo safe rollouts, we'll pause the pilot."

Ayesha (CS): Affected accounts: AcmeHealth (pilot, renewal Q3), Broadview (trial conversions). Acme explicitly called out needing an 'audit' view for billing.

Tom (Product): OK. What are suggested solutions? Quick wins vs. product work?

Jit (Eng): Quick wins:
- surface per-route cost in console (UI flag + CSV export)
- warning modal for runs > X tokens
- add `billing.toggle` to disable per-route routing for trial projects
Product work:
- rollout dry-run flow (control plane + canary metrics)
- prompt templating UI for admin-managed templates (2-3 sprints)

Tom (Product): Can we get mocks? @design — low-fi first.

Ayesha (CS): I'll schedule a 30m review w/CS + PMs tomorrow 10:00am PT and paste customer quotes into the doc. Adding labels: #renewal-risk #billing #q2-asks :eyes:

FeedbackBot: New doc created: https://redwood.company/docs/feature-requests/1732104567-feature-ask-spotlight — 'Feature Ask Spotlight: per-route billing & rollouts'

Tom (Product): For prioritization, propose: per-route billing visibility = P0 (Q2 quick-win), rollout dry-run = P1, prompt templating = P2. Agree? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

Carlos (CSM): +1 from CS — per-route billing visibility likely to mitigate immediate renewal risk for 2 accounts.

Ayesha (CS): +1 — I'll surface this in tomorrow's renewal sync.

Tom (Product): Cool. I'll put a ticket in the backlog for the quick-win and loop Eng. Jit, can you estimate effort by EOD?

Jit (Eng): On it — will drop a short estimate and spike tasks by EOD.

Carlos (CSM): Thanks everyone. If you have more customer nuggets, paste them here before the 10am sync.
